required_tests.assertion: Recompute 133 stages and exact 94/15/10/14 authority-mode counts from reviewed source/catalog.
Reject derived authority on any unlisted stage or an unreviewed authority-mode substitution.
Reject wrong/late/foreign producer lineage and process-exit-only evidence; support exact multi-producer restore lineage.
T05-D/F00-10/F00-11 reject stale pre-ENGINE material/profile and require signed post-ENGINE rebind.
All six verify-after-import stages bind actual destination material/registration; T00-09/T09-A also bind export checkpoint lineage.
Derived native-binding template cannot alter executable policy, paths/volumes, timeout ceilings, payload authority or action set.
ENTRY_ONLY remains exact reviewed entry-probe authority and cannot be mapped to a product purpose.
FENCE_BOUND_RECONCILIATION rejects a foreign/missing fence or detached-read lineage and preserves original-plan identity.
Five concrete temporal exceptions remain fail-closed exactly as reviewed.
All nine late-bound proof roles reject materialization before scope facts exist and enforce role/scope/freshness.
Policy generation increments exactly by one and rejects parent digest drift, rollback and signed-base-ref mutation.
Derived refs under multi-valued roles require verified signed-slot lineage; registration/design/code remain single-selection.
execute_stage and finalizer reject plan/stage evidence whose authority mode or lineage does not match signed suite authority.
No public/caller-selected dynamic-plan or prepare_execution bypass can create accepted LAB stage evidence.
V02 static verification distinguishes concrete, slot, entry-probe and reconciliation-slot resolvability without claiming future facts exist.
Author tests/tooling never sign, read private signing-key material, write production mappings, run native LAB cases, issue qualification or set HOST_READY.
